body: Read remaining EMILY.wiki ECOWAR docs (spec-1/2/3). Spec-2/3 duplicated SPEC-4 material already in §22.1. Spec-1's Jungle Camps & Dragons section named 3 new things: spawn telegraph, camp buffs as a missing mechanic, boss-death-as-match-event pattern. Multi-biome map idea named as explicitly out of scope. No code changes.
title: NORTHSTAR §22.5: ECOWAR wiki follow-up folded into jungle camps spec
